Hey, I'm Liv

YOUR LIFESTYLE & POSING COACH

My background is in elite sport, and that athlete's mindset, discipline, structure and a relentless focus on performance, shapes how I coach today. Every session has a purpose, and every block builds towards a goal.

I've spent the last two years being coached by Chloe, learning the Limitless approach to training, nutrition and stage prep from the inside, and in 2025 I stepped on stage for my first competitive season as a natural Wellness athlete.

I now coach women 1-1, combining training and nutrition programming with dedicated posing coaching, the kind of detail that can make the difference between looking good and looking stage-ready.

As the newest member of Team Limitless, I bring the same standard of coaching, the same attention to detail, and the same belief that the right plan, built around you, is what gets real results.

8 Weeks · 4.7kg Difference

My client Anna, when she came to me, felt stuck in the same cycle of bulking and cutting, changing direction every couple of months and never really giving herself enough time to see progress. She knew the basics of what she needed to do, but needed direction, accountability and someone to take the guesswork out of the process. So that's exactly what we focused on: giving her a clear goal and structure with her nutrition and training, while supporting her through each phase rather than constantly second guessing what she should be doing. We also put a big focus on her training, improving form, execution and intensity so she could get more out of every session. There's 8 weeks and 4.7kg between these photos, but more importantly, she finally had a clear direction and a process she could trust.

Anna Coached By Liv
10 Weeks · 6.1kg Difference

This is my client, who came to me just 10 weeks ago. After having her daughter and experiencing two further pregnancies that sadly ended too soon, she wanted to start prioritising herself again and rebuild confidence in herself and her body. Just 10 weeks later, there's 6.1kg between these photos. But this has been about so much more than weight loss. We've focused on building sustainable habits around nutrition, learning how to properly fuel her body and creating structure that works around her life, without feeling like she needs to eat as little as possible to see results. Alongside that, she's been consistent with her training, getting stronger and building confidence in what her body is capable of.
